*The [[Kenya]]n electoral commission confirms that the opposition [[National Rainbow Coalition]] (NARC) has won landslide victories over the ruling [[Kenya African National Union|KANU]] party in Friday's elections, ending 40 years of single party rule and 24 years of rule by [[Daniel arap Moi]].  The NARC's presidential candidate, [[Mwai Kibaki]], led by more than 30 percentage points over the KANU's official candidate.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/africa/2612427.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Africa - Kenya victor vows to tackle corruption|publisher=|accessdate=30 December 2015}}</ref>
*[[Brighton]], [[England]]'s historic West Pier partially collapsed.  It had served from the [[Victorian era]] until it was closed in 1975.<ref>http://www.guardian.co.uk/arts/news/story/0,11711,866543,00.html</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.chron.com/cs/CDA/story.hts/world/1718590 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2015-06-06 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050305161902/http://www.chron.com/cs/CDA/story.hts/world/1718590 |archive-date=2005-03-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
